_comment: Exemptions from the per-case gate (eval/run_eval.py --per-case). Every row declares a kind. weak_gold: at baseline the gold was outside the top 20 of BOTH single channels (pure BM25 / pure dense, measured with the case's own filters), so its baseline pass was RRF coincidence. accepted_regression: a real loss under a new snapshot that the owner accepted explicitly, with the measured cause and an exit condition. Filing a real regression as weak_gold is forbidden. Ranks below: baseline = index rebuilt at e6f9928, which reproduces baseline_indy.json exactly. See eval/ACCEPTANCE.md (2026-10-22).

fix_list.disputed: Holds only for an unfiltered measurement (baseline bm25 137 / dense 25). With the case's own filter (repo=inference) baseline dense was 15, i.e. inside the top 20; its baseline R@10 pass (rank 6) rested on the dense channel alone. Re-decide when the next retrieval change lands. 2026-10-26 retrieval change (old category token in the embedding text -> cause subsystem KV缓存) moved it further out (dense 27 -> 72; 32 with no category token at all); kind not re-decided yet, see eval/ACCEPTANCE.md 2026-10-26.
fix_list.why: Vague query ('不管输入啥，续写永远是最开始那条的'). The symptom is in the entry (effect.detail: 第二个 prompt 返回第一个 prompt 的内容，decode 输出无视新输入), but several entries share the surface symptom, and bge-m3 scores the paraphrase only 0.445 against that field.
fix_list.exit: Remove once the gold is back in the top 10 on the current snapshot.
